PRB_Recent.title: Accurate computation of the energy variance for ground states and $〈〈{\mathcal{L}}^{†}\mathcal{L}〉〉$ for steady states using iPEPS
PRB_Recent.summary: Author(s): Emilio Cortés Estay, Naushad A. Kamar, and Philippe Corboz Infinite projected entangled-pair states (iPEPS) provide a powerful tensor network ansatz for two-dimensional quantum many-body systems in the thermodynamic limit.
